Game Overview

Unbroken Soul is a platformer title where in Unbroken Soul, guide King Tyrion's spirit through a vibrant 2D realm, overcoming perilous traps and foes. Master your reflexes to conquer cunning monsters and gather power to reclaim life and defeat the necromancer Elaniof, all while upgrading Tyrion's arsenal with found treasures. Adventure awaits!
